verdict.rationale: No first-party evidence documents licensing terms, a free community edition, or whether commercial or enterprise use needs a paid license. The only signal is one community comment saying RCLI is MIT-licensed while the MetalRT engine is commercial, and that the repo is misleading about it. That is third-party, and it points to unclear licensing rather than a documented answer. Cloud usage billing is a different capability and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
